title: Stereotactic MRI Based Image Guidance for the Treatment of Vascular Malformations - a Pilot Study
brief_summary: Treatment of vascular malformations requires the placement of a needle within anatomically non well defined, pathological vessels, which may be as small as 1 mm, with the current state of the art relying exclusively on two dimensional fluoroscopy images for guidance. The investigators hypothesize that the combination of stereotactic image guidance with existing targeting methods will result in faster and more reproducible needle placements.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with venous or mixed venous-lymphatic malformation
* Patients which are regular scheduled for a percutaneous treatment of a vascular malformation
* Informed Consent as documented by signature

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years
